run_ray_intersection: run ray intersection against primitive geoms using the ray function with model, data, origin, and direction arrays
run_rays_multiworld: run batched ray intersection for multiple worlds and rays using the rays function with optional BVH acceleration
test_ray_capsule_intersection: test ray-capsule intersection computation returning distance and surface normal in local and global frames
test_ray_box_intersection: test ray-box intersection computation returning distance, per-side info, and surface normal
test_ray_mesh_bvh: test BVH-accelerated ray-mesh intersection query returning hit distance, normal, barycentric coords, and face index
